description: Check that showtime is installed and working (ffmpeg, Python, Node, browser, models). Returns PASS/WARN/FAIL per item with a one-line fix. Run this first; if setup is missing it says the exact command to run.

background.description: answer at once with a task id and keep working in the background; the status tool with {"task": id} reports progress and the result. Default false: wait for the result (a host with a short tool-call limit gets a task id after about 20 s anyway).

full.description: also launch a browser and run a test encode (slower, about 30-60 s). Default false.

name: doctor
title: Check the showtime installation
